name: Pit Fiend
summary: A mighty devil general that bites, claws, and wields a fiery mace.

traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
traits.text: If the pit fiend dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {ref:glossary/hit-points} somewhere in the Nine Hells.

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.text: The pit fiend emanates an aura in a 20-foot {ref:glossary/emanation} while it doesn't have the {ref:condition/incapacitated} condition. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* {dc:con}, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. *Failure:* The target has the {ref:condition/frightened} condition until the start of its next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this pit fiend's aura for 24 hours.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: If the pit fiend fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The pit fiend has {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The pit fiend makes one Bite attack, two Devilish Claw attacks, and one Fiery Mace attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.onHit: If the target is a creature, it must make the following saving throw. *Constitution Saving Throw:* {dc:con}. *Failure:* The target has the {ref:condition/poisoned} condition. While {ref:condition/poisoned}, the target can't regain {ref:glossary/hit-points} and takes {dmg:6d6:poison} at the start of each of its turns, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: Hellfire Spellcasting
actions.text: The pit fiend casts *{ref:spell/fireball}* (level 5 version) twice, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {dc:con}). It can replace one *{ref:spell/fireball}* with *{ref:spell/hold-monster}* (level 7 version) or *{ref:spell/wall-of-fire}.*
